decision.reason: The only upstream text, [ev-565f3761f656], says the Helm chart now quotes "nodeSelector values". That supports behavior-changed as the change type, but it does not say which values keys are affected. The validator confirms that a top-level `nodeSelector` key exists in both releases [ev-717ddb6f40cd][ev-7a67f12867b2]. That proves the key exists, not that this fix is limited to it: the chart may have per-component nodeSelector keys, and this text cannot rule them in or out. Deciding the subject needs the PR #7579 template diff, showing which nodeSelector keys are now quoted.
